paths.name: @/lib/supabase/admin
paths.message: createAdminClient bypasses RLS with the service_role key. Import it only from lib/actions/**, lib/audit.ts, app/api/**, or scripts — prefer createClient() from @/lib/supabase/server in anything else.

paths.name: @supabase/supabase-js
paths.message: Never build a Supabase client directly. Use createClient() (lib/supabase/server.ts or client.ts) or createAdminClient() (lib/supabase/admin.ts).

paths.name: @supabase/ssr
paths.message: Never build a Supabase client directly. Use createClient() (lib/supabase/server.ts or client.ts) or createAdminClient() (lib/supabase/admin.ts).
